biggest_catch: The $600 is paid $100 at a time, one month at a time: you must have $1,000+ in qualifying direct deposits each month for up to 6 months — if you don't earn direct-deposit income, you earn nothing, and there is no catch-up.
catches: Earn $100 per month, up to 6 months, for each month (starting the calendar month after account opening) in which $1,000+ in qualifying direct deposits posts. A missed month only forfeits that month's $100 — you are not disqualified from later months.

Qualifying direct deposits are regular income from an employer or third party (salary, paycheck, pension, Social Security, government benefits) via the account and routing numbers. Excluded: teller deposits, wire transfers, ATM transfers/deposits, BMO Digital Banking transfers, debit-card credits, real-time credits, transfers from any bank or brokerage, account-to-account and P2P transfers (Zelle, Venmo).
Primary applicant must reside in AZ, CA, CO, FL, IA, IL, IN, MN, NM, NV, OR, UT, WA, or WI at the time of application — 14 states only.

The promo code applies to the first Smart Money, Smart Advantage, or Relationship Checking account opened between September 9, 2026 and December 15, 2026; one bonus per customer, no stacking multiple accounts.
Each $100 bonus is paid approximately 10 days after the beginning of the next month; the account must be open, in good standing, and have a balance greater than zero when each bonus is paid.
Cash bonuses may be reported to the IRS for tax purposes; you are responsible for applicable taxes.
Offer can be changed or canceled without notice and cannot be combined with any other offer.
Monthly fees: Smart Advantage $0 with paperless statements; Smart Money $5 (waived if under 25); Relationship $25 (waivable with $10,000 minimum daily balance or $25,000 combined balances).
